recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. Future work should only change source if an active extension/profile has an approved FMM value update or if Extension Pack registry generation stops exposing maturity/status.
issue_request: FHIR-11245 is Published/Persuasive and requested a maturity model for extensions, including registry-page exposure. The accepted resolution required spreadsheet-authored extensions to declare FMM levels, XML-authored extensions to use the existing structuredefinition-fmm extension, and registry tooling to expose FMM levels for extensions and profiles that declare them.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN revisions 10480-10484 rather than a git commit naming FHIR-11245. Imported commit 8bffa4f35aba636d69f24fbf71e9d57b5686b6bf at SVN @10480 added FMM/status rows to extension and profile templates, spreadsheet parser support for extension FMM metadata, and FMM columns in generated extension/profile listings. Commit 361b374c6d228a8b6a69d4d1bbcb2d1931f30c3c at SVN @10484 refined profile/extension metadata rendering and registered the structuredefinition extensions spreadsheet in source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: Current publisher implementation code has moved out of this checkout, but current core source still retains the profile and extension page template metadata hooks and active extension/profile spreadsheet entries. The active extension registry and canonical FMM extension now live in the FHIR Extension Pack, whose registry legend describes Status as a status-and-maturity summary. FHIR-11247 directly points back to FHIR-11245 for profile maturity and is already represented on the combined branch; later FHIR-18277 confirms that maturity applies to IGs and other artifacts including extensions and profiles.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The requested capability is already represented by active core templates/source inputs and active Extension Pack registry/FMM definition source, while assigning or changing specific extension FMM values would be a separate artifact-specific decision.
